listing.title: Doula Contracts, Deposits and Payment Plans Excel Template: Balance Ageing, Unearned Cash, Refund Tracker, Cash Forecast
listing.headline: Know what is paid, late and unearned, from signing to the birth
listing.description:
Run the money between signing and the birth for a doula practice or agency in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-doula and an admin who track deposits, balances, payment plans and refunds. Contracts records every client with the package, price, deposit, balance due date and payment plan, and works out the balance, the next due date, the overdue amount and the ageing band. Instalments, Payments and Hour Packs keep every payment, every instalment and every prepaid pack.

Deposit Tracker, Balance Due List and Ageing Buckets show who owes what in bands of 0 to 30, 31 to 60 and 61 or more days. Instalments Before the Window shows plans that end after the on-call start. Unearned by Client and Unearned by Month show cash received for work not yet done (unearned cash, also called deferred revenue). Refunds and Changes and the change rate by month show cancellations, package changes and the cash kept and refunded against a rate you set.

18 calculators cover the deposit and balance tracker, a payment plan builder, prepaid earned against unearned, the refund analyser, a cancellation settlement, overdue ranking, reminder timing, plan risk, a 12-week cash forecast, deposit share, a prepay discount, contract changes, hour pack release, late payers, card fees, window entry and reconciliation. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to clients, the owner-doula, the admin and the accountant.

This is part three of the Doula Business suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Clients appear by name, package, dates and money only, with no medical detail. It helps you keep track of your money and does not promise results. Check your local rules for contract terms.
